verdict.rationale: monday.com documents first-party programmatic access that can run without the UI: a GraphQL API for automating processes, SDKs, and the ability to run and manage agents from your own code "anywhere you need it." Nothing shows a CI-oriented tool such as a CLI, CI integration or pipeline guidance, so headless use is supported through the API but CI usage is only implied. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g., pipeline action/runner), documentation of non-interactive/CI usage patterns, hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run and manage every monday agent programmatically from your own code, anywhere you need it.
An expressive GraphQL API to interact with your workflows, automate processes, power integrations, and more!
Use our flexible APIs, SDKs to build custom apps and integrations tailored to your  unique needs.
